{{Top|leg}}
The '''Scanning hood''' was a medical device used to examine [[Brain/Legends|brain]] activity. It projected a [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] image of the brain being examined and displayed its brain waves beneath the hologram. The device could be used with a brain mapper to analyze neurological activity.<ref name="JK">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref>

In [[35 ABY/Legends|35 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]'' to [[35 ABY/Legends|35 ABY]].</ref> [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Cilghal]] performed tests on four [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi]]: [[Tesar Sebatyne]], [[Tahiri Veila]], [[Tekli]], and [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]]. They all wore scanning hoods while Cilghal and the other Jedi Masters present observed their brain patterns.<ref name="JK" />
